blocking_issues.issue: Both editions assert September 2026 US real disposable personal income fell 0.3% month on month and real consumption was essentially flat, but attach reference [7], which is BEA's Q3 2026 GDP advance-estimate release rather than the original Personal Income and Outlays, September 2026 release. This household-income counterpoint is central to the report's claim that strong US quarterly GDP coexists with weak household purchasing power. The stated values are correct, but the cited original does not document them, breaking claim-level source traceability under EDITORIAL-STYLE.md.

Reference [7] in both editions is 'GDP (Advance Estimate), 3rd Quarter 2026', 29 October 2026: https://www.bea.gov/news/2026/gdp-advance-estimate-3rd-quarter-2026

The required original is BEA 'Personal Income and Outlays, September 2026', 29 October 2026, with Real DPI −0.3% and Real PCE 0.0% (rounded): https://www.bea.gov/news/2026/personal-income-and-outlays-september-2026
